scripts.translation:
[遊蕩的靈魂]
活人可不能參加尼芙菲姆的慶典。-giggle-

scripts.text:
[Wandering soul]
The festival brought vitality to 'city of the dead'....
Doesn't it seem like something is wrong??
scripts.translation:
[遊蕩的靈魂]
慶典給“死者之城”帶來了生機...
是不是哪裡不太對勁？？

scripts.text:
[Wandering soul]
Soon, the festival of souls will be here!
scripts.translation:
[遊蕩的靈魂]
很快，靈魂節就要到了！
